levitate.line: …now. The tips of her fingers are blackened and the Darkhold is <mark>levitating</mark> beside her)
levitate.def: Cause to rise in the air and float, as if in defiance of gravity.
levitate.explain: Wiktionary puts it as: To cause to rise in the air and float, as if in defiance of external forces such as gravity. Close cousins: hover. A kind of raise. It can also mean: be suspended in the air, as if in defiance of gravity.
levitate.ety: Borrowed from New Latin levitātus, perfect passive participle of levitō (“to levitate; to have one's motion directed upward, as opposed to the downward motion induced by gravity”) (first attested c. 1670), modeled on gravitō (“to gravitate”) (← Latin gravis), from levis (“light”), see -ate.
